name: Musia
subtitle: Hear the beat. Play along.
short_description: Practice guitar at your pace with song loops, chord shapes and a steady pulse.
description:
Start making sense of music, one small phrase at a time. Musia brings listening, rhythm practice and guitar play-along into the same workspace. You do not need to sing before you begin.

START WITH A STEADY PULSE
Begin with First Pulse, a short synthesized reference exercise using Em and Am. Listen, tap along, then practice a chord change at a comfortable speed.

PRACTICE AT YOUR PACE
Slow down or speed up playback from 25% to 200% while preserving pitch. Replay a phrase, set a loop, and follow timed lyrics and available guitar chord diagrams. All 24 major and minor chord shapes include finger positions, open and muted strings, and barre markings.

LISTEN AND EXPLORE
Explore a curated library with Japanese, Chinese and English vocals. Use background playback and native media controls to keep listening. Streaming songs requires an internet connection.

KEEP YOUR PROGRESS LOCAL
Practice history stays on your device. Export or clear it when you choose. No account, advertising or subscription is required.

Automatically analyzed song chords, beats and melody are estimates, not a verified score. Tap feedback measures your tapping, not guitar performance or singing ability. The current release does not record your microphone, analyze user uploads or offer cloud music generation.
review_notes: No login, subscription, microphone permission or special hardware is required. Open Library > First Pulse. Listen has four count-in beats; the Em/Am changes start at 4, 8, 12 and 16 seconds. Try Tap and Play modes, 0.25x/1x/2x speed, looping, and the history export/reset controls. Library also offers streamed songs with timed lyrics and estimated chords. The owner confirmed audible playback and screen-locked playback on an iPhone using this build. Synthesized First Pulse is a known reference; other music analyses are explicitly estimates, not verified scores. This native release does not expose our separate desktop AI-generation tools. The catalog, lyrics and artwork are distributed with the owner's commercial authorization.
release_notes: First public release: guided listening and rhythm practice, pitch-preserving playback speed, phrase loops, timed lyrics, all 24 major/minor guitar chord diagrams, and device-local practice history.
